paragraphs: An E. coli and Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts remains ongoing, with 76 cases and 6 hospitalizations across 16 states as of October 1 [1]. Two other recent outbreaks have ended: a Salmonella outbreak linked to jalapeños affected 488 people across 34 states with 65 hospitalizations [2], and an E. coli O145 outbreak linked to frozen blueberries sickened 17 people across 2 states with 6 hospitalizations [3].

Do not consume Lemon Alfredo Fettuccine by bettergoods sold at Walmart nationwide due to potential Listeria contamination [6]. Avoid Fromagerie Coop de Mean and Belgium Cabricharme cheeses sold in CA, AZ, NJ, MA, RI, CT, and NY because they may contain undeclared egg allergen [5]. Broccoli sprouts by Evergreen Fresh Sprouts distributed in Washington may contain Salmonella [7]. Grace Ready to Eat Chicken Vienna Sausages (140-g cans) illegally imported from Jamaica were found in AL, FL, GA, MD, and TX [12].

Additional recalls include YUPI pork cracklings from Colombia found in eight states [4]. Two broccoli seed products were recalled for potential Salmonella: HOME GROWN Green Sprouting Calabrese Broccoli Seeds sold nationwide [18] and Calabrese Broccoli Seeds by Eden Brothers in 1-ounce and 1-pound packets [14]. Nature's Own Hawaiian Bread contains undeclared milk [20], and frozen pizzas by Saint Francis Apizza lack soy allergen labeling [23]. Stewart's ice cream flavors Heavenly Medley and Vanilla-Chocolate-Strawberry may contain metal pieces [17].
